sovereign_country.strategic_role: 海湾阿拉伯国家自贸走廊、外资100%控股与印度洋海运枢纽

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Maritime Seafarer Staffing and Vessel Crew Management Agency

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Companies Law, Royal Decree No. 18/2019, as amended by Royal Decree No. 53/2020 (Arts. 1-4 on company forms, legal personality and share capital; Single Person Company chapter); Foreign Capital Investment Law, Royal Decree No. 50/2022 (100% foreign ownership of an Omani Single Person Company/SPC); implementing circulars and fee schedules issued by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) - Commercial Registration Directorate and Investor One-Stop Shop 'Invest Easy' (investeasy.om), in coordination with the Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Single Person Company Incorporation Application together with notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association (MOA/AOA) filed electronically via the Invest Easy portal and authenticated by the MoCIIP Notary Public Office.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Under the Foreign Capital Investment Law (RD 50/2022) there is no mandatory minimum paid-up capital for the seafarer staffing activity; however, the SPC chapter of the Commercial Companies Law requires an issued capital of not less than OMR 500 (approx. USD 1,300) to be subscribed and fully paid in cash before commercial registration. The amount must be deposited into a commercial bank account opened in the SPC's name and evidenced by a paid-up capital certificate; no separate government escrow account is required.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [OMANI SPC]. The sole shareholder resolves: (1) The Commercial Registration Certificate No. ___ issued by MoCIIP is ratified. (2) The issued capital of OMR ___ comprising one fully subscribed share is accepted and recorded as paid. (3) The registered office at ___, Muscat, Sultanate of Oman is adopted as the statutory seat for official and judicial notifications. (4) ___ is appointed Manager/legal representative with authority to open bank accounts, execute contracts, procure the maritime crew manning license, and file statutory returns. (5) The company seal is approved. (6) The Manager may take all ancillary actions to complete incorporation and licensing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Corporate Bank Account and Capital Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Commercial Bank in Oman regulated by the Central Bank of Oman (CBO)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the notarized MOA/AOA and manager appointment, open the SPC corporate account; deposit the fully subscribed capital of at least OMR 500 and obtain a paid-up capital certificate from the bank; configure SWIFT wire acceptance and multi-currency payroll capabilities for future crew salary disbursements; complete CBO-standard AML/KYC forms including source of funds and anticipated transaction profiles.
required_dossiers: Notarized MOA/AOA of the SPC
Passports and certified IDs of shareholder, manager and authorized signatories
Formal board resolution approving bank mandate and payroll accounts
AML/KYC forms and corporate structure certification required under CBO rules
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank imposes enhanced due diligence, provide apostilled corporate documents and a bank reference letter; if the account opening is rejected, approach another licensed bank and repeat the KYC pack; CBO ombudsman escalation is available for unreasonable delay beyond 15 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP Commercial Registry through the Invest Easy One-Stop Shop
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized MOA/AOA, the paid-up capital certificate, the registered office lease/usufruct contract and the foreign investor approval (where applicable) through Invest Easy; the system calculates registry fees; pay the fee electronically; obtain the SPC Commercial Registration (CR) certificate containing the national company number and statutory activity code for ISIC 5222; the registry automatically notifies the Tax Authority, PASI, Ministry of Labour and OCCI of the new registered entity.
required_dossiers: Notarized MOA/AOA
Bank paid-up capital certificate (minimum OMR 500)
Registered office lease contract or usufruct deed in Muscat Governorate
Foreign Capital Investment Law approval or exemption certificate (if applicable)
Invest Easy CR application form and fee payment confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the CR application is queried, correct the flagged fields online and resubmit within 30 days; if suspended for incomplete dossiers, provide the missing document and pay the re-filing fee; disputed rejections may be appealed administratively to MoCIIP within 60 days of notification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Social Insurance, Labour and Chamber Post-Incorporation Registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA), Public Authority for Social Insurance (PASI), Ministry of Labour, and Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete automatic registration derived from CR data on OTA e-services: corporate income tax registration and VAT registration (if the SPC exceeds OMR 40,000 annual threshold or voluntarily registers for input VAT recovery); register as an employer with PASI for all Omani/GCC employees; obtain a Ministry of Labour establishment file for expatriate quota and Omanisation compliance; collect the OCCI membership certificate required for commercial activity licensing.
required_dossiers: SPC Commercial Registration certificate
MOA/AOA and manager appointment decision
OTA corporate tax and VAT registration forms
PASI employer registration form and employee data if hiring initially
Ministry of Labour establishment registration and Omanisation plan
OCCI membership application and fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registries report CR data mismatches, request re-synchronization from MoCIIP and reload the e-files; if tax or PASI registration is delayed, file a written follow-up through the authority's e-service ticketing system; late-registration penalties are waivable where the delay is caused by registry misfiling.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Maritime Crew Agency License and Premises Occupational Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (MOTCIT) - Marine Administration Licensing Division, jointly with the Ministry of Labour (Private Recruitment Agency Licensing) and the local Municipality / Civil Defense Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the maritime manning agency license application citing CR activity ISIC 5222; attach the registered office lease, manager's maritime staffing experience evidence, MLC 2006 compliance manual and Seafarer Employment Agreement templates; obtain MOTCIT crew manning permit; concurrently apply for the municipal business license and Civil Defense fire safety certificate for the office premises; present the physical office inspection report for occupancy clearance.
required_dossiers: SPC Commercial Registration certificate and notarized AOA
MOTCIT marine manning license application form and license fee proof
MLC 2006 compliance policies, crewing procedure manual and grievance mechanism
Seafarer employment agreement templates
P&I/liability insurance certificate covering crew recruitment operations
Office lease, municipal occupancy permit and Civil Defense fire safety certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MOTCIT requests supplementary technical or safety documentation, respond within the 30-day cure window; if the license is refused, submit a written appeal to the Marine Administration's licensing committee and, if still unresolved, to the administrative court in accordance with the Omani Maritime Law.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (MOTCIT) - Marine Administration / Maritime Licensing Directorate, jointly with the Ministry of Labour (Directorate General of Employment and Private Recruitment Agencies), and municipal authorities of the Governorate of Muscat for physical premises licensing.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Maritime Crew Manning / Seafarer Recruitment Agency License (Ship Manning Agency Permit) issued under the Omani Maritime Law and the Maritime Labour Convention 2006 framework.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority of the Sultanate of Oman (formerly Ministry of Environment and Climate Affairs)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category E3 - Environmental Registration (No Substantial EIA): administrative and office-based crew recruitment activity does not trigger a Full Environmental Impact Assessment; only an environmental self-registration with the Environment Authority is required prior to commencing operations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or VOC-bearing industrial emissions arise from the shore office. Sanitary wastewater must be discharged exclusively to the municipal sewerage network in accordance with Muscat Municipality bylaw limits for domestic effluent (BOD5 ≤ 300 mg/L, TSS ≤ 350 mg/L unless more restrictive inflicated); solid waste must be segregated under municipal waste management rules. Any vessel-facing operational standards are incorporated into seafarer employment contracts and include MARPOL Annex V waste management and MLC 2006 accommodation/ventilation obligations, which are verified during ship manning inspections.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Clearance Certificate from the Civil Defense and Ambulance Authority (CDAA) covering office premises (fire detection, extinguishers, emergency exit and evacuation plan); municipal structural/occupancy inspection and commercial occupancy permit from the respective Governorate Municipality; Ministry of Labour workplace clearance validating passage widths, ergonomic workstation layout and seafarer interview/medical assessment room requirements. No nuclear, radiation, or high-risk industrial clearances are applicable to this activity.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA) through the unified national e-Tax portal (https://eservices.taxoman.gov.om), integrated with the Invest Easy single-window of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP) and the Royal Oman Police – Customs Authority (Bayane single-window) for border/customs procedures.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: The foreign shareholder incorporates the Single Person Company via MOCIIP Invest Easy and obtains the Commercial Registration Certificate together with the sectoral licence for maritime crew recruitment and vessel crew management (ISIC 5222) issued by the competent transport/maritime licensing authority. Step 2: The commercial registration is digitally linked to the OTA, which automatically generates the corporate Tax Identification Number (TIN) for the SPC. Step 3: Where the SPC's annual taxable supplies or chargeable turnover equals or exceeds OMR 38,500, the SPC must file a VAT registration application with the OTA through the e-Tax portal within the statutory deadline, submitting the Commercial Registration Certificate, the activity licence, the constitutional documents (singular shareholder resolution), proof of registered office, bank confirmation, and a completed VAT registration questionnaire; a non-resident taxable person is obliged to appoint an Omani tax representative. Step 4: The SPC completes employer registration with the Public Authority for Social Insurance for any Omani/GCC national administrative staff and obtains the final VAT registration certificate. Step 5: The SPC is then activated for corporate income tax filings, withholding tax submissions, VAT return filing, and electronic invoice issuance in the OTA portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the Omani SPC is a juridical person resident in Oman for tax purposes, subject to corporate income tax on its worldwide income at the statutory rate of 15%, with a reduced small-business rate of 3% applicable to taxable income not exceeding OMR 100,000; the SPC is separately liable for VAT and no pass-through or disregarded-entity treatment is available to the foreign shareholder.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Omani law does not provide a US-style check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election regime. Available statutory elections include: (i) VAT group registration for related persons satisfying common ownership and financial control conditions; (ii) voluntary VAT registration where taxable supplies exceed OMR 19,250 but remain below the OMR 38,500 mandatory threshold; (iii) election of the small-business corporate income tax rate for taxpayers with taxable income not exceeding OMR 100,000; (iv) application for advance clearance or tax rulings regarding characterization, withholding tax, and transfer pricing treatment; and (v) election of payment schedule alternatives under the tax procedure rules where available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Royal Decree 121/2020 (Oman VAT Law) and its Executive Regulations, aligned with the GCC Common VAT Framework.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: OMR 38,500 on annual taxable supplies for mandatory registration; voluntary registration is available from OMR 19,500 in annual taxable supplies; registration obligation is assessed on a rolling 12-month basis.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The OTA has published the national e-invoicing framework with a phased implementation roadmap; as of the current compliance stage, real-time B2B API fiscal clearance, digital stamping, and e-fiscal clearance of every invoice is not yet fully enforced. However, all VAT invoices and credit notes must be issued electronically in the OTA-prescribed digital format, made available in machine-readable form (XML/QR-code integrated) during audits, and the SPC must maintain API-ready invoicing infrastructure in anticipation of the mandatory live-reporting and clearance obligation once the OTA fully activates the national e-invoicing platform.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available for (a) export of goods physically removed from Oman to a destination outside the GCC; and (b) supplies of services that are directly connected with international transportation of passengers and goods, or services supplied to a non-resident recipient where the benefit of the service is enjoyed wholly outside Oman. For a ship crew recruitment and vessel crew management agency, the 0% rate may be claimed where the SPC supplies seafarer recruitment, manning, payroll administration, or crew management services to a non-resident shipowner, fleet operator, or overseas manning office for vessels engaged in international voyages, provided the recipient's non-resident status is documented and the service is not consumed for cabotage included in domestic Omani trade. The zero-rated invoice must satisfy the OTA invoicing form and content requirements and the claim must be supported by the documentary bundle retained for audit.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Zero-rated VAT invoice issued in the OTA-prescribed electronic format

Signed crew manning/recruitment service agreement and the non-resident shipowner's or fleet manager's foreign tax status evidence (overseas VAT registration certificate, foreign TIN, or certificate of residence)
Bayane Customs Export Declaration and Bill of Lading or Airway Bill (applicable when the engagement involves physical movement of goods, crew articles, or ancillary export consignments)
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank foreign-currency settlement record evidencing the repatriation of export consideration into the Omani banking system

Vessel and seafarer deployment records, including crew manifests, seafarer employment contracts, discharge books, international port-call itinerary, and evidence that the vessel is engaged in international rather than domestic Omani voyages
Copy of the OTA export/vessel services filing record and any supporting certificate requested by the OTA during post-audit verification
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The OTA may reverse zero-rated export treatment and reclaim the VAT benefit where documentation is incomplete, the vessel or service is found to have been used for domestic cabotage, the recipient is determined to be a resident of Oman, or the service benefit is enjoyed within Oman. The remedial consequence is a retrospective assessment of output VAT together with input VAT credit clawback, monthly late-payment delinquency penalties applied to unpaid tax, fixed administrative fines per the OTA penalty grid for documentary and invoicing violations, and, in cases of deliberate misstatement or fraudulent zero-rating claims, criminal prosecution carrying imprisonment and significant financial penalties; the SPC is required to retain all export and zero-rating evidence for at least five years, or a longer period where litigation or audit is pending.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO) — Sultanate of Oman; the CBO is the sole foreign exchange and banking supervisory authority, with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion regulating the commercial register and foreign investment license.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Omani Rial (OMR) is fully convertible for all current account transactions, including trade, payroll, and service payments, subject to standard anti-money-laundering checks. Capital account flows, including inbound foreign direct investment and shareholder loans, require only bank intermediation and statistical reporting to the CBO; there is no prior exchange control approval for profit remittance. Profit remittance from a foreign-owned Single Person Company is unrestricted after corporate tax clearance (Oman corporate income tax at 15%) and submission of audited financial statements; no withholding tax is imposed on dividends or branch profit remittances to foreign shareholders. Practical hurdles include strict KYC documentation, source-of-funds substantiation, and CBO transaction reporting thresholds for outward remittances above OMR 10,000 equivalent.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Oman imposes no statutory mandatory surrender or conversion ratio on export proceeds. Marine crew recruitment and vessel management service receivables may be retained in OMR or any approved foreign currency. There is no prescribed timeline for conversion or repatriation, but supporting export/remittance documentation, including invoices and crew contracts, must be retained for at least five years for CBO and tax audit purposes.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Multi-Currency Operational Account
SPC Settlement and Foreign Currency Payroll Account
Corporate Operational Account with Crew Welfare Fund Sub-Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility for offshore digital EMIs. Under CBO regulations applicable to electronic banking and payment services, only CBO-licensed financial institutions may hold client operational balances or process local-currency payroll. Offshore EMIs such as Wise, Revolut, or Payoneer are not permitted as primary treasury or payroll clearing accounts for a licensed Oman SPC; they may be used only as ancillary disbursement rails where funds are first cleared through a CBO-licensed Omani bank, and even then legal exposure remains due to unlicensed foreign capture. Clients with strong compliance posture may engage a CBO-licensed payment service provider for cross-border payroll aggregation before migration to a full-tier bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory. At least one fully authorized director or senior signatory, ideally the sole foreign shareholder, must attend an in-person KYC/onboarding meeting at the chosen bank's main branch in Muscat or an authorized regional branch. Remote and video-based KYC is not accepted for a newly incorporated foreign-owned SPC without an existing banking relationship. In practice, banks require physical attendance for signing of the account mandate, power of attorney, and corporate resolution, and may request a second physical visit for high-value FX or credit authorization. Some banks permit a preliminary document review by email, but the statutory onboarding interview must occur in-country.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border payroll payments to seafarer jurisdictions with elevated money-laundering or terror-financing risk (e.g., Philippines, Bangladesh, India, Myanmar)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full crewing license under ISIC 5222; commercial registry extract (CR) and Chamber of Commerce certificate; executed seafarer employment agreements with salary schedules; valid passports and Seafarer's Discharge Book / International Convention on Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping (STCW) certificates; manning agency agreement between the Oman SPC and vessel owner; per-crew payroll ledger; source-of-funds evidence for the initial payroll balance; third-party vessel screening report; and a written corporate AML/CFT policy adopted by the sole shareholder.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Nominative or opaque ownership of the foreign SPC with unresolved Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO) identification
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized and apostilled memorandum of association; certificate of incorporation of the overseas parent; UBO declaration form listing all natural persons with 10% or greater control; power of attorney granted to the resident signatory; bank reference letters from the shareholder's home-country bank; audited financial statements and tax returns of the parent; source-of-wealth statement signed under penalty of perjury; and comprehensive sanctions/UBO screening using a registered commercial data provider.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High debit-to-credit velocity with rapid outward funds movement and no prior banking relationship in Oman
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written treasury policy and cash-flow budget approved by the sole shareholder; detailed 12-month crew payroll projection; original commercial invoices and vessel management contracts; CBO transaction declaration forms for all outward transfers exceeding OMR 10,000 equivalent; corporate tax registration and statement of no dues from the Oman Tax Authority for the prior period; and, where applicable, a clearing settlement agreement with the foreign vessel operator that validates the commercial purpose of each outbound payment.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity capital injections for the Omani SPC are routed through the CBO-licensed banking system exclusively via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 for high-value transfers. The remitter must instruct the foreign bank to use the standard FDI / capital contribution purpose code and cite the Oman commercial registration number (CR) in the remittance narrative. The receiving Omani bank will require the notarized share subscription agreement, CR certificate, SPC incorporation documents, and a board resolution confirming the shareholder's capital commitment. The CBO imposes no prior approval threshold for equity injections below OMR 100,000, but banks must file a balance-of-payments/statistical return for all inbound investment; funds must be held in the SPC's name before conversion to operating assets. For working capital loans, a documented shareholder loan agreement and a CBO notification form are mandatory to avoid future characterization as deemed equity.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade and payroll disbursements are cleared through tier-1 Omani banks using SWIFT MT103 payments for all crew wages and ordinary supplier disbursements. For vessel charter, major fuel, or repair contracts exceeding an equivalent of OMR 500,000, an irrevocable commercial letter of credit (LC) confirmed by a reputable international bank is the standard clearing rail; the LC must reference the underlying crewing or maritime service contract and be issued in compliance with the Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits (UCP 600). Smaller operational payments are executed via corporate internet banking after FX confirmation and AML sanctions screening. Every outward payment is subject to CBO reporting if above OMR 10,000 equivalent, and the bank must retain a copy of the crew payroll or commercial invoice in its AML/CFT file. Cross-border payroll to seafarers is best executed through a dedicated multi-currency account with local correspondent banks in the seafarers' home countries to minimize fees and counterparty risk.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: CBO-approved OMR/USD spot and forward transactions; the forward is primarily used to lock in USD liquidity rates for vessel-owner settlements due to the OMR's pegged exchange rate, eliminating USD basis risk.
Cross-currency outright forward contracts between OMR and seafarer home currencies (notably PHP, INR, BDT, IDR, EUR, and GBP) to hedge payroll liabilities and operating expenses.

Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) on OMR where onshore hedging limits do not cover the full notional; permitted only with CBO-licensed counterparties or international banks authorized under CBO market practice, and subject to mandatory underlying exposure verification.
Cross-currency interest rate swap (CIRS) or principal-only currency swap with a CBO-licensed bank for long-term multi-currency crew financing or vessel acquisition debt.
Natural hedging through dual-currency invoicing and multi-currency payroll netting, combined with a rolling 30-day forward hedging ladder to reduce FX conversion costs.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) - Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the CR anniversary date; renewal may be filed during the 30 days preceding expiry.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers MoCIIP penalty fees per published tariff; continued non-renewal beyond the grace period may lead to suspension and administrative strike-off of the commercial registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return with Audited Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the end of the tax accounting year; for a calendar-year SPC, by 30 April.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing or omission exposes the SPC to OTA late-filing and late-payment penalties, plus reassessment interest; substantial default may result in suspension of the commercial registration and enforced collection.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Owner (UBO) Annual Confirmation and Update Notification
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MoCIIP e-Services - Register of Beneficial Owners
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On each CR renewal date and within 15 days of any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance attracts penalties under Oman's AML Law and beneficial-owner registration rules; repeated violations may lead to personal liability for the SPC manager and registration suspension.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements and Auditor's Report Approval and Retention
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Retained at the registered office; presented to the sole member or general assembly; available to OTA on demand.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the close of the financial year, consistent with the tax return deadline.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to prepare and audit financial statements violates the Commercial Companies Law and exposes the SPC manager to fines and disqualification remedies under Omani law.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: The Oman Commercial Companies Law requires every SPC, regardless of turnover, to appoint a licensed auditor and have its annual financial statements audited; no size-based exemption applies to SPCs.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as applied under Omani regulations; no separate local GAAP is recognized for commercial registrants.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SPC manager must maintain an internal beneficial-owner register at the registered office. Any share transfer or change in ultimate beneficial ownership must be recorded in the statutory register and reported to MoCIIP within 15 days. An annual no-change confirmation is made through the MoCIIP CR renewal process, and the SPC must retain UBO identity and source-of-funds evidence.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15% flat CIT (Royal Decree 6/2023 – Unified Tax Law, effective tax year 2024)
